test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 20 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: ________, conferred the prestigious Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards (Akademi Puraskar) for the years 2022 and 2023 to 94 eminent artists.

options.text: Defense Minister of India, Shri. Rajnath Singh
Prime Minister of India, Shri. Narendra Modi
President of India, Smt. Droupadi Murmu
Home Minister of India, Shri. Amit Shah

solution:
The correct answer is __**President of India, Smt. Droupadi Murmu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** **Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards:**

 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards, also known as the Akademi Puraskar, are prestigious national honors bestowed upon eminent artists in the fields of performing arts.
 
• These awards recognize outstanding contributions to music, dance, theatre, traditional folk arts, and puppetry.
 
• The awards are presented by the Sangeet Natak Akademi, India's national academy for music, dance, and drama.
 
• The awards are a symbol of excellence and recognition in the performing arts.
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi is an autonomous body under the Ministry of Culture, Government of India.
 
• The awards aim to preserve and promote the rich cultural heritage of India.
 
• The awards are given annually, but in this case, the awards for two years were given at the same ceremony.
 
• The 94 eminent artists were selected for their significant contributions to their respective fields.
 
• The awards are presented in a formal ceremony, highlighting the importance of the arts in Indian culture.
 
• The President of India, Smt. Droupadi Murmu, conferred the awards, emphasizing the national significance of the event.
 
• The award ceremony serves as a platform to celebrate the diverse and vibrant artistic traditions of India.
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi plays a crucial role in fostering artistic talent and promoting cultural exchange.
 
• The awards contribute to the preservation of traditional art forms that are integral to India's cultural identity.
 
• The awards provide encouragement and recognition to artists who have dedicated their lives to the performing arts.
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi awards are one of the most respected awards given to artists in India.
 
• The awards cover a wide range of artistic disciplines, reflecting the diversity of Indian performing arts.
 
• The ceremony highlights the importance of cultural preservation.
 
• The President of India's participation underscores the government's commitment to supporting the arts.
 
• The awards are a testament to the dedication and talent of Indian artists.
